summary: Join our Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) Systems Training to develop critical skills in risk management and compliance strategies for your organization.
lede: GRC system training shows risk, compliance, audit, and control professionals how to manage governance information in an integrated platform. Participants learn to structure policy and risk registers, map controls and obligations, manage incidents and audit actions, and build dashboards from GRC data. It is intended for practitioners and leaders who use or oversee GRC processes and need to configure, operate, or improve system-based workflows for oversight and decision-making.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who touch governance, risk, compliance, audit, or control environments and either use or plan to use GRC systems:
audience: Risk managers and enterprise risk management (ERM)
Compliance officers and regulatory affairs specialists
Information security, cybersecurity, or data protection officers
ESG, sustainability, or ethics and integrity leads
modules: Foundations of Governance, Risk and Compliance and GRC Systems
Structuring Governance and Policy Management in GRC Platforms
Building and Managing Risk Registers in GRC Systems
Controls Design, Testing, and Monitoring in GRC Tools
Compliance Management and Regulatory Obligations Tracking
Incident, Issue, and Case Management in GRC Systems
Internal Audit and Assurance within GRC Platforms
Dashboards, KRIs, and Reporting from GRC Data
Integrating GRC Systems with Other Enterprise Tools
Implementing and Optimizing a GRC System
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of governance, risk, and compliance concepts, and be familiar with the general operation of GRC systems.
